component: Tie the policy notice to active policy state and measured sticky height

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The preferences notice appears when Services.policies is ACTIVE and links to about:policies. Its wording indicates management rather than claiming every preference is disabled. The selected code measures the actual sticky container, adds focus-rectangle space and applies scroll padding to main content. Fixed source retains this condition and measurement; rendered geometry, policy setup and accessibility were not tested.
title: Tie the policy notice to active policy state and measured sticky height
